misprints.note: Article printed without its rough breathing and accent; kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The punctuation after ἡ looks like a broken '.:' (a faint middle dot, then a full stop). Transcribed as '.:'.
The diacritic on ἔξω is small and hard to read in the scan. Transcribed as smooth breathing with acute.
The breathing on the first letter is small. It looks rough, so it is transcribed as ἁπλοῦς.
The full stop after ἡ is faint and raised, but there is a dot, so it is kept.
